query: Add a mode that overlaps two molecules on a new per-atom scalar field the Molecule doesn't carry yet as an INDEPENDENT Gaussian field channel (not shape-weighted).
expected_behavior: Recognizes get_overlap_esp folds in the shape Gaussian and is therefore NOT usable for an independent field, so writes a new pure overlap in score/<family>_scoring.py (plus the _np mirror), inputs in and scalar out, no optimization.
Verifies by hand that the new channel scores exactly 1.000 for a molecule against itself under Tanimoto, matching numerator and self-overlap widths/masks.

Adds the per-atom property to Molecule via the trio, as a full (N,) RDKit-mol-order array sliced by the same _nonH_atoms_idx the charges use; guards the atom-order and retained-H traps and keeps gate 5.
Names by mode id; registers only _ALIGN_KEYS; align_with_<mode> uses literal defaults; exports the new score function from score/__init__.py.
Test passes all gates including the planted-pose recovery (the only gate that catches a consistently-wrong atom-order mapping); tests/test_mode_registry.py passes unchanged.
